description: This file implements the Ocdm class and factory functions related to the Open Content Decryption Module (OCDM) within the Rialto server namespace. It manages creation and access to OCDM instances and checks for support of specific content key systems.

classes.name: OcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing singleton instances of IOcdm.

classes.name: Ocdm
classes.description: Class providing OCDM-related functionalities, such as checking if a key system type is supported.

methods.name: IOcdmFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IOcdmFactory instance.

methods.name: OcdmFactory::getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton IOcdm instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Ocdm::isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system type is supported by the OCDM.
